ns2:section.sectionText: Applied aircraft design. In this introductory class, students will investigate fundamental aerodynamics, performance, stability & control, propulsion and structures as applied to airplanes. Flying vehicle demonstrations will be presented, discussed, and analyzed with emphasis on design and practical considerations in aerospace engineering. Student teams will construct a glider to demonstrate principles of aerodynamics, flight dynamics and aircraft stability & control. Enrollment is limited to aerospace engineering majors.
